## What happened

Include the task, expected outcome, and observed result. Small examples are useful.

## Context

Tool and version, model if known, AIBoot source version, installed files, and
relevant existing project guidance. Remove private information.

## Evidence

Share reproducible steps or a brief redacted artifact. Distinguish a loading
failure from an instruction that loaded but did not help.
